description: Pre-registered EFC predictions P1-P8 extracted from EFC_Predictions.html. v2.0 (2026-04-29) adds P7 (H0 three-window decomposition, DOI 32113399) and P8 (bar-instability falsification, DOI 32101111), and registers supporting April 2026 DOIs (32101213 alpha non-MCMC, 32084670 structural closure, 32080083 RCMP DES Y6+KiDS, 32114530 VAL-2026-006 corrigendum). Content is hand-curated by Morten; this JSON is the structured source-of-truth for graph ingestion.

items.name: Lensing crossover at z ≈ 0.44
items.claim: The effective lensing amplitude Σ_eff(z) is non-monotonic with a sign change at z ≈ 0.44. EFC predicts enhanced lensing at z < 0.4 and suppressed lensing at z > 0.5. This profile is absent in ΛCDM and in standard QS Horndeski models with α_T=0.
items.test: Euclid DR1 tomographic cosmic shear (4+ z-bins, Oct 21, 2026)
items.falsifier: A monotonic Σ_eff(z) across all bins with no sign change inside z ∈ [0.3, 0.6] falsifies the prediction.

items.name: fσ8(z=0.7) = 0.430
items.claim: The regime-transition growth model predicts fσ8(z=0.7) = 0.430 vs ΛCDM 0.449. Joint BAO distance prediction: D_H/r_d(z=0.7) = 19.797 vs 20.719; D_H/r_d(z=1.0) = 16.527 vs 17.466. As of 2026-04-26, the α-parameter underlying P2 is independently constrained to α ∈ [−0.72, −0.68] via non-MCMC BAO+Growth+Cluster analysis (DOI 32101213).
items.test: DESI DR2 full-shape RSD at z ~ 0.5-0.7 (release pending 2026)
items.falsifier: Measured fσ8(z=0.7) > 0.449 at > 3σ — i.e. consistent with ΛCDM at high significance — damages but does not kill EFC (point prediction, not structural).

items.name: E_G enhancement: E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012
items.claim: Galaxy-CMB-lensing cross-correlation combined with RSD produces the gravitational slip estimator E_G. EFC predicts E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at k_c ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc and z_eff ≈ 0.5, driven by the combination μ < 1 with Σ > 1. As of DOI 32084670 (2026-04-23), this prediction is now structurally closed: the μ/Σ system has unique solutions under EBE constraints, eliminating any free-parameter escape route.
items.test: Simons Observatory CMB lensing × Euclid DR2 galaxy catalogue (~2027-2028)
items.source_evidence: DOI 32023788, sealed 15 Apr 2026 with SHA-256 falsifier; DOI 32084670 (structural closure, 2026-04-23)

items.name: Rubin DP2 cosmic shear S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015
items.claim: Large-scale cosmic shear ξ_+ enhancement of ~8% at angular scales 20'-300', producing S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015. Discriminates EFC from f(R) (which predicts μ > 1) and from background-only entropic gravity models. Now also testable via the formal RCMP DES Y6 + KiDS Legacy protocol (DOI 32080083, 2026-04-22) which specifies the regime-consistent measurement procedure for current Stage-IV weak lensing data.
items.test: Rubin LSST DP2 (Jul-Sep 2026); DES Y6 + KiDS Legacy via RCMP (2026)
items.falsifier: DP2 + Euclid DR1 combined return S8 consistent with Planck ΛCDM (0.811 ± 0.006) at < 1σ — the S8 tension dissolves and EFC loses its primary motivation.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32013738 (sealed); DOI 32080083 (RCMP test spec, 2026-04-22); DOI 32084670 (structural closure)

items.name: Horndeski no-go (structural)
items.claim: Standard quasi-static Horndeski with α_T=0 and c_s² > 0 cannot produce μ < 1 and Σ > 1 simultaneously — the action forces Σ ≤ μ universally. EFC breaks this via the Lagrange-multiplier flow constraint.
items.test: Full numerical scan of (α_B, α_M) parameter space (done, 135,000 points; 0 Horndeski solutions vs 15 EFC solutions)
items.falsifier: If P1+P3 (lensing enhancement with growth suppression) is confirmed, standard Horndeski is excluded as the mechanism; EFC or an equivalent slip-extension is required.

items.name: Background sign lemma
items.claim: ΔE²(z) ≤ 0 for all z > 0, i.e. H_EFC(z) ≤ H_ΛCDM(z). Reduced Hubble friction enhances growth; analytically proven (Lemma 1) and numerically verified at A ∈ {0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 5.0}.
items.falsifier: A counterexample at any z > 0 with A in the tested range would falsify the lemma. Analytical proof currently closed.

items.name: H0 three-window decomposition
items.claim: The Hubble tension is not a free-parameter degeneracy but a regime-mixing artefact. EFC predicts that Planck (L0 background), DESI BAO (L1 transition), and SH0ES (L2 perturbation) measure H0 in distinct regime windows that do NOT need to coincide. Three-window decomposition reproduces all three observed values within EFC consistency. Atlas role upgraded 2026-04-29 from addresses_open to proposes_resolution.
items.test: Joint regime-disaggregated chain on Planck + DESI DR2 BAO + SH0ES + Euclid DR1 shear; regime-mixing operator from EFC EFT (DOI 31878334).
items.falsifier: If a single common H0 fits all three regime probes within ±0.5 km/s/Mpc, the regime-mismatch hypothesis is falsified.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32113399 (2026-04-28); supports atlas role-upgrade EFC → H0_tension proposes_resolution

items.name: Bar-instability falsification (Π_EFC criterion)
items.efc_value: Π_EFC = σ_R·κ_eff/(3.36·G·Σ) < 1 (stable); EFC predicts modified κ² from entropy-gradient coupling
items.lcdm_value: Efstathiou-Lake-Negroponte (ELN) criterion: ε_ELN = V_max/√(GM_d/R_d) > 1.1 implies bar instability
items.claim: The classical Efstathiou-Lake-Negroponte (ELN) bar-instability criterion is observationally falsified at population level. EFC replaces it with Π_EFC = σ_R·κ_eff/(3.36·G·Σ) < 1 where κ_eff incorporates the entropy-gradient correction. Among 42 frameworks in the EFC atlas, EFC is the SOLE addresser of bar_instability_L3 (no ΛCDM, MOND, Verlinde, f(R), DGP equivalent prediction exists).
items.test: Cross-population test against SPARC (175 galaxies), S4G (~2300), Galaxy Zoo bar-fractions; falsification protocol pre-registered as vc_140e79363cbe.
items.falsifier: If observed bar fractions follow ELN within ±10% across SPARC+S4G mass bins, the EFC Π-criterion is falsified.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32101111 (2026-04-26); fills atlas gap bar_instability_L3 (only L3 monopoly in EFC atlas)
